data.title: bn-2304: fix owner-cohort success-path disarm race and panic-in-Drop
data.description: engine.rs TestOwnerCohortGate. (1) RACE: wait_until_cohort_admitted disarms on success (armed=None + notify_all when admitted==expected); wait_until_admitted read admissions only via armed and had no generation guard, so a waiter woken by that success notify saw armed==None and failed 'owner cohort was disarmed before the requested admission' despite its admission landing. Fix: retain the generation's admission count in TestOwnerCohortState (reset in arm, bumped in record_admitted) so it survives the disarm; waiter is now generation-aware and checks that count. Abandonment (count < at_least, or re-arm) still asserts. (2) PANIC-IN-DROP: the assert panicked holding the MutexGuard, poisoning it; TestOwnerCohortGuard::drop -> disarm() unwrapped the poisoned lock -> panic in Drop -> SIGABRT, destroying the diagnostic. Fix: recover the poisoned guard in disarm(). Found by bn-d0x6 v4 rehearsal (ast-rb-check --smoke exit -6). cargo test -p mess-store all suites pass 0 failed; cargo +nightly fmt --check clean. Commit 69901f2.
